'''Encaasa Bareesh''' was a junior nephew of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Tassaa Bareesh]]. Bareesh oversaw the security detail of a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] in [[3643 BBY]].
